record.oneLiner: A large tyrannosaurid predator of Late Cretaceous Alberta.
record.description: Gorgosaurus was a large bipedal tyrannosaurid predator of western North America, 8–9 m long, with dozens of sharp teeth and small two-fingered arms. It was a close relative of Albertosaurus and a more distant cousin of Tyrannosaurus.

notableFacts.text: A close relative of Albertosaurus, and among the best-known tyrannosaurids.
Like other tyrannosaurids, it had tiny two-fingered forelimbs.
